items.question: What arises when one knows the hidden true nature of that?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature yields all-knowingness.
items.inference: Knowledge of the hidden true nature produces all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Knowing that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
